description: A directory holding one loadable catalog and one CHILD DIRECTORY NAMED LIKE A LOADABLE CATALOG (de.json) that itself holds one. Reaches loadFromDirectory:1247's skip arm: the child is not descended into, so fr never loads. Measured on the pinned JDK before authoring. The child's NAME is load-bearing: a first draft named it 'child', which the filename-to-tag test silently skips anyway, so ablating the directory skip changed nothing and the case was vacuous. Named de.json, the directory skip is the ONLY thing that skips it -- without it the walk reaches the not-a-regular-file guard instead.
